description: The BTPS 1.2 document rules, read as documents.vectors.json is (apply `fill` and `repeat` first). Each case names `version`, the version of the artifact the document travels in: 1.2 rules apply only under 1.2.0, and under 1.1.0 a document is read exactly as 1.1 reads it. An implementation accepts every "accept" case and refuses every "refuse" case; `why` says what is wrong.
